# Goal
mado round 51, wave w2 = falsification of the two frozen claims. Lane: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin; axes coverage + operability. Round base 6ca8c559a4a3d6d361101592116eea2bc7452437; freeze revision 56026fcb9800370ae04bc65952a6567181c398d0; C2 data revision a0e34387b30538372a1bb219eb3ccdc74013d458. Read `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/claims.md` and `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/registration.md` FIRST. Exact predicates and controls are frozen; do not amend them. C1 is the tool-ledger capability; C2 is the sourced dispatcher-dispatch entry. W1 yielded 43/43 settled seats; the delivered outputs are under `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/w1/` and results `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/w1-results.json`. C1 measured TARGET_MET at the freeze commit; C2 measured TARGET_MET at data commit.

# Scope and rules
- Attack the frozen predicate/counter, data artifact, gate decisions and evidence. Findings are advisory; report PASS/MISS under the exact frozen sentence, with commands and pointers. Any suggested fix is a future amendment unless it exposes a concrete failure that the current claim fails; never silently edit the frozen predicate or change lane files.
- Write ONLY in your own seat dir `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/w2/<YourSeatName>/` plus report `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-51/w2/<YourSeatName>.md`; no tracked code edits. L1 alone integrates/commits. Never touch fleet outside lane, sibling lanes, `MANIFEST.json`, templates, scripts, `.ufo/state`, `.scratch`, or shokuknow (read-only). No mutating git/jj. No config-plane writes, compositor sockets or service changes. Absolute paths only; tools start at fleet root.
- Every `Report:` trailer is relative to `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin`: write at `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>`. Declare each deliverable under `## Deliverables` and `Report:`; ensure it exists. Start report before work. No `agent://all`, no delegation, no ask tool.
- Scratch only under `/fast/scratch/hyaku/mado-r51/<YourSeatName>/`; honor TMPDIR/--work and delete on exit. No hardcoded /tmp in probes. Check disk guard before heavy work.
- Tooling auth: read `/home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md` before any install; pacman transactions are paused host-wide. No install is required for these attacks.
- No installs performed. Seats route by role through the host table; never pass models.
